name: Release Please (versioning)
description: Keeps 1 open Release PR on the default branch. A merge of the Release PR writes CHANGELOG.md, updates the version number and creates the vX.Y.Z tag. It then calls the WP Engine Production Deploy workflow with the tag, so add that template too. Also needs .github/release-please-config.json, .github/.release-please-manifest.json and .github/VERSION: copy all 3 from client-repo-templates/ in 434marketing/.github. Turn on 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests' in the repository settings.
